name: What's the best time of year to visit Palm Beach for ideal weather and fewer crowds?

mainEntity.name: What's the best time of year to visit Palm Beach for ideal weather and fewer crowds?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal time to visit Palm Beach for pleasant weather and generally fewer crowds is typically from late spring (April-May) or early fall (October-November). During these periods, the intense heat and humidity of summer begin to subside, and the peak tourist season of winter hasn't fully started or has ended. However, 'fewer crowds' is relative, as Palm Beach remains a popular destination year-round. When planning your visit, consider any specific events or festivals you might want to attend, as these can impact crowd levels and accommodation availability regardless of the season.
